$comment: Session 1's title page, word for word (GAME_DESIGN 18.11): off main since S2 (decision 64), retired on preview from S7 (channels.preview.off), and retired unanswered when main gets the title screen and the cabin. From S7b the title screen's one line of its own, title.prompt (decision 74; B002 line 40), preview only until B002 is answered. The name over the cover is app.name; the label over its summit is the gazetteer's place.mount_olympus_west_peak (content/art/title.json).

title.tagline.ctx: Session 1's title page: the line under the name

title.start_label.ctx: Session 1's title page: VoiceOver's name for the section under the cover (main labels it app.name)

title.begin.ctx: Session 1's title page: the start button, disabled (hidden on main until it does something)

title.begin_note.ctx: Session 1's title page: the note under the start button (hidden with it)
